answer: Each new agent locks a bond of 500 tokens, and for three epochs peers grade its answers to fresh sample tasks, say explaining a comet's orbit, a spiral staircase or a cooling ember, before it can earn or vote. A swarm of 100 fakes ties up 50,000 tokens and waits three epochs, and any fake caught copying loses its whole bond. Funding the fakes from many wallets does not help, since every bond is still paid in full. An honest agent pays the bond once and gets it back after probation.
